solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Check with painter, one in old working-class movement

parts.note: CH is the chess abbreviation for check
a painter is an artist

explanation.surface: A query about checking a painter who belonged to a nineteenth-century workers' movement.
explanation.walkthrough: Chartism was a British working-class campaign of the 1830s-40s for votes and parliamentary reform.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the Chartist movement, which pressed for the People's Charter in Victorian Britain, is so called.

clue.text: Streetcar has clipped hobo

indicators.note: clipped means the word for hobo has its final letter cut off

parts.note: a hobo is a tramp, a homeless wanderer

explanation.surface: A streetcar is carrying a hobo with a trimmed haircut.
explanation.definitionFit: Streetcar is the American word for a rail vehicle running along city streets, a synonym.

clue.text: Copper to assess vicar's assistant

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
to rate is to assess or value

explanation.surface: A policeman is sent to evaluate the clergyman's helper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' suggests a policeman but gives the chemical symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: A curate is a junior Anglican cleric who assists the vicar of a parish.

clue.text: Research papers, original sheets

indicators.note: original here means freshly made, so the letters of sheets are formed anew

explanation.surface: Academic research papers are printed on new sheets.
explanation.definitionFit: Dissertations written for a degree from original research are plural of thesis.

clue.text: A pianist could play this essential sheet

parts.note: something key is essential or crucial
a board is a flat sheet of wood or similar material

explanation.surface: An essential sheet of music that a pianist might perform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sheet' looks like sheet music but means a flat panel.
explanation.definitionFit: The row of keys on a piano is the instrument a pianist plays, described here loosely.

clue.text: Continuous pain? One must ring hospital

indicators.note: must ring means the word for one has to encircle the hospital letter

parts.note: an ace is the one in a suit of cards
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: Someone with persistent pain is told to phone the hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ring' looks like a phone call but means surround.
explanation.definitionFit: A dull, steady pain that persists is a synonym of this word.

clue.text: Meticulous from beginning to end, assuming nothing

indicators.note: assuming means taking on or taking in, so the phrase for start to finish absorbs the zero

parts.note: through means from start to finish, as in read it through
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Be meticulous all the way through, taking nothing for granted.
explanation.definitionFit: A careful, painstaking person or job is complete in every detail, which is the sense here.

clue.text: Every single fruit having penny off

indicators.note: off means the penny letter is taken away from the fruit

parts.note: a peach is a fruit

explanation.surface: Every piece of fruit has been marked down by a penny.
explanation.definitionFit: Every single one and each one mean the same: all individually, a synonym.

clue.text: Unlawful act beginning to annexe part of Ukraine

parts.note: a crime is an unlawful act

indicators.note: beginning to means take only the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: An illegal act begins the annexing of part of Ukraine.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface recalls Russia's 2014 annexation of the peninsula.
explanation.definitionFit: The Crimean peninsula on the Black Sea is internationally recognised as Ukrainian territory.

clue.text: First of bids in auction for a fur

indicators.note: in means the letter is placed inside the word for auction

parts.note: an auction is a sale

indicators.note: First of means take the opening letter of the word bids

explanation.surface: The opening bids at an auction for a fur coat.
explanation.definitionFit: Sable is the costly dark fur of a small marten-like animal, an example of a fur.

clue.text: Secure floor, right away

indicators.note: away means the right letter is removed

parts.note: a floor or storey can be called a tier, one level of many

explanation.surface: Fix the floor and then move to the right.
explanation.definitionFit: To tie something is to fasten it firmly, so make it secure, a synonym.

clue.text: Fill in puzzle

definitions.meaning: to pepper with holes, as with bullets

explanation.surface: Complete the puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: A target riddled with bullets is filled with holes; a puzzling question is also a conundrum of this name.

clue.text: Groom ahead of time in equestrian event

indicators.note: ahead of means the grooming word comes before the time word

parts.note: to groom is to dress, to make neat
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A groom gets ready early for a horse show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Groom' suggests a stable hand, which fits the scene, but it is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: This competitive discipline tests a horse's precise trained movements, one Olympic riding event.

clue.text: Seafood affected is taken back outside

indicators.note: outside means the reversed pair sits around the word for affected
taken back means the word is reads backwards

parts.note: camp means affected or exaggeratedly theatrical

explanation.surface: Pretentious seafood gets sent back by a diner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken back' makes SI, which then wraps around CAMP.
explanation.definitionFit: Breaded langoustine tails, a popular British pub dish, are a kind of seafood.

clue.text: Travel document graduate left

parts.note: to graduate is to pass, succeed in an exam or course
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: A graduate leaves behind a travel document.
explanation.definitionFit: The official document a traveller shows at borders is this, the obvious example.

clue.text: Anxiety of rest working on board

indicators.note: on, read with board, means placed within the ship, so the shuffled letters go inside

parts.note: SS, steamship, stands for the vessel one goes on board, a long-standing crossword convention

indicators.note: working means the letters of rest are put to work in a new order

explanation.surface: Worry about relaxation while on duty aboard a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' is the familiar crossword signal for going inside SS, the steamship abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Mental strain or worry is a synonym of anxiety.

clue.text: Small wagon hit

parts.note: a truck is a wagon, as on a railway

explanation.surface: A small wagon collided with something.
explanation.definitionFit: Struck is the past tense of strike, so it means hit, a synonym.

clue.text: Unassuming ways associated with leader of team

parts.note: modes are ways or methods

indicators.note: leader of means the first letter of the word team

explanation.surface: The team captain has a self-effacing manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone humble who does not boast of their achievements is unassuming, a synonym.

clue.text: Eel, new in, served with a cheese sauce

indicators.note: in means the new letter goes inside the eel

parts.note: a moray is a kind of eel

explanation.surface: An eel dish served with a newly made cheese sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: Béchamel enriched with grated cheese is the classic French sauce of this name.

clue.text: Likewise at solo, ignoring the odds

indicators.note: ignoring the odds means skip the odd-numbered letters and keep the even ones

explanation.surface: Someone else also goes solo, defying the odds.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying 'me too' or 'me likewise' both mean also, the same.

clue.text: In tearoom, I served penny-pincher

indicators.note: In means the letters lie within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A waitress in a tearoom serves a stingy customer.
explanation.definitionFit: A stingy person who hoards money is a penny-pincher, a synonym.

clue.text: Horse from Durham area

indicators.note: from means the letters are taken out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A horse from the north-east of England.
explanation.definitionFit: A female horse is a specific kind of horse.

clue.text: Instructions read initially, before piece cooked

indicators.note: before means the first letter comes ahead of the rest
initially means take the first letter of the word read
cooked means the letters of piece are rearranged, as a cook prepares ingredients

explanation.surface: Read the directions first, then cook the piece of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of cooking directions for a dish is a set of instructions.

clue.text: Tease small company doctor

parts.note: Co is the short form of company
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: Mocking a little firm's medic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tease' means to untangle hair, not to mock.
explanation.definitionFit: To tease hair is to run a comb through it and separate the strands.

clue.text: Boast made by head of broadsheet paper

indicators.note: head of means take the opening letter of the word broadsheet

parts.note: a rag is a disparaging word for a newspaper

explanation.surface: The editor of a serious newspaper is showing off.
explanation.definitionFit: To brag is to talk boastfully about oneself, a synonym.

clue.text: About to put down extra for sword

parts.note: C is circa, Latin for about
to lay is to put down
more means extra or additional

explanation.surface: Someone is about to set down an extra sword.
explanation.walkthrough: A claymore is a large Scottish two-handed sword.
explanation.definitionFit: The great two-edged broadsword of the Scottish Highlanders is a type of sword.
